tests: Knowing the centralized way to prevent all member accounts from operating outside an allowed Region.
expected: An SCP on the OU with Deny if aws:RequestedRegion ≠ eu-west-1. Triggers: "no member account", "outside region", "MOST effective", "organization".
why_not: Per-user IAM policies are error-prone and bypassed by new roles; MFA on root does not restrict Regions; a permission boundary on the management account does not extend to member accounts.
